guide.summary: Harvest v3 API for many customers (partner) (partner acceptance); Custom MCP client (Dynamic Client Registration) (self-serve (no review step found in the docs)).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Custom MCP client (Dynamic Client Registration) (self-serve (no review step found in the docs)). Hardest: Harvest v3 API for many customers (partner) (partner acceptance).

composio.note: Composio lists Greenhouse as managed OAuth, which is fine for prototypes. For launch with your own branding and dedicated quota, create a custom auth config with the client ID and secret Greenhouse issues, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, since Composio manages a Greenhouse OAuth app. For launch you likely want your own: the managed app shows Composio's name, shares quota across all Composio users and limits trigger polling to every 15 minutes.
reasons: Consent screen shows your brand instead of Composio's
Dedicated rate-limit quota instead of one shared across all Composio users
Shorter trigger polling than the 15-minute managed minimum

prerequisites.title: Partner application and signed agreement
prerequisites.detail: A signed Greenhouse partnership agreement is required before you can create credentials for the Harvest v3 API. You also need an active website with a Privacy Policy and at least one mutual customer.

prerequisites.title: Customer Greenhouse Recruiting subscription
prerequisites.detail: Harvest API access is tied to the customer's Recruiting tier (Core, Plus, Pro). No separate API fee is named.

prerequisites.title: Information for the credential request
prerequisites.detail: Prepare integration name, environment, scopes, redirect URI(s) and a 128x128 logo. Customers see the logo when authorizing.

steps.title: Submit the integration partner application
steps.detail: Fill out Greenhouse's integration request form describing your integration and goals. You need at least one mutual customer first.

steps.title: Wait for monthly review and confirmation
steps.detail: Applications are reviewed on the first Monday of each month. Do not start integration steps until officially confirmed, since not all are accepted.
steps.done_when: Greenhouse confirms and invites you to sign the agreement

steps.title: Sign the Partnership Agreement
steps.detail: Legal sign-off on the agreement Greenhouse sends. Credential steps only proceed once it is finalized.

steps.title: Draft the credential request
steps.detail: Prepare integration name, environment, minimal scope list from the Harvest docs, redirect URI and the 128x128 logo.
steps.done_when: Request text is ready to send

steps.title: Email Partner Support for credentials
steps.detail: Send the request to Greenhouse Partner Support. Start with testing, which reaches only your own sandbox, then request production.
inputs: Redirect URI copied from Composio dashboard
steps.done_when: You receive a Client ID and Client Secret

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create a custom auth config for the greenhouse toolkit with the issued client ID and secret. Keep the secret confidential.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists and a test connection succeeds

steps.title: Submit for Partner Directory review
steps.detail: Submit your integration for review and launch in the Greenhouse Partner Directory.

steps.title: Request redirect URI allowlisting
steps.detail: Contact Greenhouse to add your client's redirect URI to the allowlist. This is a manual step today.
steps.done_when: Greenhouse confirms the URI is allowlisted

steps.title: Ask customer Site Admins to enable access
steps.detail: Site Admins enable the endpoint categories and read/write access in Dev Center > MCP Access.
steps.done_when: Categories are enabled for your tool

traps.title: The refresh token lasts 14 days and is used
traps.detail: The refresh token lasts 14 days and is used to get new access tokens. The page gives this as a general lifetime and does not say it differs in testing.

traps.title: Submitting the form is not acceptance
traps.detail: Every submission is reviewed and not all are accepted. Do not begin integration work until Greenhouse officially confirms.

traps.title: Review runs only once a month
traps.detail: Missing the first-Monday review can cost you a month. Out-of-cycle requests are generally only considered for urgent mutual-customer needs.

traps.title: Refresh token dies after 14 days unused
traps.detail: Access tokens last 1 hour and the authorization code 1 minute. If the refresh token is unused for 14 days, the user must redo the full authorization flow.

traps.title: Test credentials do not reach customers
traps.detail: The testing environment is sandbox only. Customers get access only under production.

traps.title: Redirect URI must match exactly
traps.detail: A redirect_uri not configured for the client_id returns an error. Greenhouse also checks the allowlist on every authorization, and requested scopes must be permitted for your client.

traps.title: Callback domain cannot be verified by you
traps.detail: Greenhouse checks redirect URIs against an allowlist. Composio's callback domain is not yours, so route the callback through your own domain via Composio's redirect proxy (302 redirect, no server-side fetch).

traps.title: Per-user tokens only
traps.detail: Each user must get their own OAuth token; shared credentials are rejected.

blockers.what_it_means: Greenhouse found the integration not a fit for its program and customer needs.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask the Partnerships team for feedback and consider the MCP route or a managed Composio app for prototypes.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft a clearer description of the integration and goals.

blockers.symptom: invalid_scope or HTTP 401 on code exchange
blockers.what_it_means: You requested scopes not permitted for your client application.
blockers.what_to_do: Ask Partner Support to update the permitted scopes, or reduce the scope list.
blockers.agent_can_help: Compare requested scopes with the scopes granted to the client.

blockers.what_it_means: The authorizing user lacks the Greenhouse in-app permissions for the action.
blockers.what_to_do: Have the user's Greenhouse admin grant the needed permissions.

open_questions: How long from application to signed agreement and credentials? Ask Greenhouse Partnerships or Partner Support.
Which scopes, if any, trigger extra review? Not stated; ask Partner Support.
What rate limit do unapproved apps get? Check the X-RateLimit-Limit header in the sandbox.
How long does MCP redirect URI allowlisting take? Ask your Greenhouse account team.
Can a Harvest partner app be used for multiple customers without each customer's admin action? Not stated; ask Partner Support.
